submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 3.4 cm is the best separation-only choice from the simulation, giving the highest recorded pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c: 4.792 sigma. This exceeds the 3.5 sigma separation requirement and the thickness is within the allowed 1–6 cm range. However, no humidity-ageing documentation was found for any candidate, so the hard transparency-loss requirement could not be verified; therefore this recommendation is performance-optimal but not fully compliant with all hard requirements as recorded.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Best refined simulated result is Radiator-R2 at 3.4 cm with 4.792 sigma, higher than the best Radiator-R3 result of 4.031 sigma and all recorded Radiator-R1 values.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Selected option is Radiator-R2, one of the three recorded candidates.

requirements.requirement: The pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma.
requirements.evidence: Simulation gives 4.792 sigma for Radiator-R2 at 3.4 cm, above the 3.5 sigma threshold.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: No humidity-ageing documents were found; no candidate has a verified humidity pass. Recorded submitted_documented_humidity_transparency_loss_percent is -1 and submitted_humidity_loss_documented_flag is 0.
Recommended thickness is 3.4 cm, within the allowed 1–6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
